🔥🇲🇽 <u>EL UNIVERSAL JOURNALIST QUITS AFTER FAKE MONSIVÁIS INTERVIEW USED TO SMEAR AMLO</u>

Edmundo Cázarez resigned from El Universal after admitting he had no audio for a "recovered" 1999 Monsiváis interview the paper republished to attack AMLO — a version that added a paragraph that didn't exist in 2024. Monsiváis's own family demanded proof or an apology. This is how the outrage machine works: print the smear first, find the receipt never.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>GDP ISN'T DEVELOPMENT — SHEINBAUM REJECTS THE NEOLIBERAL SCOREBOARD</u>

Sheinbaum dismissed GDP as "a very aggregate indicator that doesn't speak of many other things." Her proof: under AMLO, even with the 8-point COVID GDP crash of 2020, 13.5 million people left poverty and the minimum wage soared. "A country can grow 4% — and if the wealth concentrates in a few, poverty doesn't change."

🚨🇲🇽 <u>17 YEARS LATER, NO STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS FOR THE ABC DAYCARE KILLERS</u>

Mexico's Supreme Court ruled the 2009 ABC daycare fire — 49 children dead, 104 injured — a grave human rights violation that can never legally expire. The ruling echoes what Justice Zaldívar called an "operation of State" to shield the owners, one of them a cousin of Margarita Zavala. The court found 99.7% of IMSS-contracted daycares were violating the rules the day it burned.

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>MEXICAN CRUDE HITS $100.78/BARREL — HIGHEST SINCE 2022</u>

Pemex crude-and-condensate output rose 1.29% while exports jumped 22.72% to 513,000 barrels a day. The Mexican blend averaged $100.78 a barrel — the highest since June 2022. The oil they keep writing obituaries for is selling at its best price in four years.

🇲🇽💧 <u>MEXICO WILL BUILD THE ROSARITO DESALINATION PLANT — PUBLIC WATER OVER PRIVATE PROFIT</u>

After two failed tenders, Sheinbaum confirmed the Rosarito desalination plant goes ahead via reverse auction — "it's the only way to give water to Tijuana and Rosarito." Nearly 6 billion pesos, 2,200 liters per second, +45% water supply for both cities. The reverse auction squeezes the lowest cost out of the bidders instead of letting them name their price.

🇲🇽💵 US INFLATION HITS 4.2%, HIGHEST SINCE 2023, AS MEXICO'S FALLS TO 3.55%

The peso closed at 17.41 to the dollar on June 25, strengthening as new data showed US consumer inflation jumped to 4.2% annually in May — its highest since April 2023. Mexico's inflation, meanwhile, fell to 3.55%, its lowest in months. The country Washington keeps lecturing about "stability" is now importing it from the south.

🇲🇽⚽ WORLD CUP HAS PUMPED 17.5 BILLION PESOS INTO MEXICO IN 13 DAYS

Concanaco president Octavio de la Torre reports the tournament has already generated 17.5 billion pesos across the three host cities in its first 13 days — spillover reaching Zacatecas, Oaxaca, Hidalgo and Puebla — with a projected 65 billion total, tickets not even counted. Mexico hosting on its own terms, the derrama staying in Mexican pockets.

🇲🇽🚆 MEXICO TO OPEN TWO NEW PASSENGER TRAINS IN 2027

The México–Pachuca line is 37% built and México–Querétaro 20%, part of a 750-billion-peso passenger-rail program Sheinbaum says opens next year: "the goal is to inaugurate those trains in 2027." 33,072 military engineers — 6,380 of them women — are laying track the neoliberal era spent decades dismantling.

🚨🇲🇽 DEA NOW CALLS MEXICAN CARTELS "FOREIGN TERRORISTS"

DEA chief Terry Cole named the Sinaloa Cartel and CJNG his top targets, vowing to "hunt the foreign terrorists responsible" for fentanyl and citing 14,000 kg and 62 million pills seized. That "terrorist" label is the legal scaffolding Washington has been building for unilateral action inside Mexico. Sheinbaum's line hasn't moved: coordination yes, subordination never.

🇲🇽🏭 MEXICO'S CONSTRUCTION SECTOR GROWS FOR 7TH STRAIGHT MONTH

While US outlets keep writing Mexico's economy off, INEGI reports construction grew another 0.4% in April — seven consecutive months of expansion. The 4T's public-works model — trains, refineries, hospitals and housing built without new debt — keeps cranes in the sky while private capital sits on its hands.
